modelUnavailable: No model list available in this install

meta.title: Nextsteps
meta.description: Suggested next-step prompts under every finished agent turn — one click sends the followup.

intro: Suggested next-step prompts under every finished agent turn — one click sends the followup.
setLanguageTip: Followups are generated in this language. Auto follows the conversation; an explicit language uses a separate call.
setMaxTip: How many suggested prompts the model should produce (1-6).
setHeaderTip: The small “Suggested followups” label above the cards.
setStylesTip: The angles the suggestions should cover. The generator varies the prompts across the selected styles. At least one style stays selected.
setGenModeTip: Auto suggests the followups when the turn ends; on demand waits for your button.
setBudgetTip: How long the generator may run before the request is given up (5000-120000 ms).
setMaxCharsTip: The maximum number of characters of one suggestion (60-600).
copyFailed: The suggestion could not be copied.
srCopied: The suggestion was copied to the clipboard.
srDiscarded: The suggestion was discarded. Use Undo to bring it back.
srFavorited: The suggestion was saved as a favourite.
favoritesExportFailed: The favourites could not be exported.
newChatUnavailable: Starting a new conversation is not available here.
manualCopy: Development or renamed copy — update it manually.
